P: When something keeps changing, what counts as one thing, and what keeps it the same one? Two ways of staying the same can come apart. At sea, the same water is passed by wave after wave, and the same wave moves on through new water: each stays the same while the other changes. ICW does not call either one the real thing. Its test asks whether the sea's own movement keeps both going, or one is just a way of sorting it. The test's last step is unfinished, so nothing has passed yet.
F1: This repository holds the specification of Identity in Changing Wholes, with worked examples, notes and two checking scripts. Each sits in its own folder: specs, examples, notes, tools.
